page.layout: One printed page, single column of running text with indented list lines, a woodcut of an armillary sphere in the middle, a caption "H Circuli" beneath it, and a handwritten manuscript note at the foot (not printed; left out of the text, described under notes).

main_text.p: id maius est quod centrum continet, minus alterum.
Maiores sex numerantur nominibus, situ, usuque distincti.
Sed plures multò sunt, ut Circuli per Zodiaci polos & stellarum centra definiti, qui circuli LATITVDINVM vocantur.

page.notes: The woodcut shows an armillary sphere with a zodiac band and a central earth; no text inside it except zodiac signs. The handwritten marginal/foot note in ink reads approximately "Circuli velut normae sunt ac regulae, ad determinandos motus coelestes inventae." It is manuscript, not printed, and is therefore not transcribed as text. The caption "H" and "Circuli" under the figure are printed. Page number and running head are not printed on this scan. The scan carries a digitiser's watermark "http://rcin.org.pl", which is excluded. The printed "LATITVDINVM" is set in spaced capitals, and "Maiores" line is indented as a paragraph start.
